newsitem.title: USA: Alignis' chiropractic network expands coverage.
newsitem.headline: Alignis' chiropractic network expands coverage.

text.p: Alignis Inc said Wednesday it has three new contracts to provide coverage for chiropractic services to 10 million people.

The company said it signed an agreement with Austin, Texas-based USA Managed Health Care Organization to add Alignis' chiropractic network to USA Managed Health Care's list of providers serving 10 million people nationwide.

Alignis said it has an agreement with Vincam Group Inc to provide chiropractic coverage for the 400,000 workers that Vincam leases to other employers. The coverage is included under Vincam's workers' compensation plan.
Alignis said it signed an agreement with Charlotte, N.C.-based Managed Care USA to provide chiropractic coverage to the 175,000 members of its health and workers compensation insurance plans.
Alignis is a privately owned company that manages a network of chiropractors, podiatrists and acupuncturists in 19 states, it said.
